```plato
//==
// # Planar triangles and quadrilaterals
//
// The straight-edged planar regions: the triangle, the general simple
// quadrilateral, and the parallelogram spanned from a corner by two side vectors.
// Each stores the minimal defining data; derived measures come from the interfaces it
// implements. Winding convention: counter-clockwise is positive.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Winding, handedness, and normals.

// Three vertices, counter-clockwise for positive area
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Triangle). Degenerate when the vertices are
// collinear.
type Triangle2D
    implements IGeometry2D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IArea, IBounded2D, IPointSet2D, ICentroid2D, IContainsPoint2D, INearestPoint2D, IDeformable2D
{
    A: Point2D;
    B: Point2D;
    C: Point2D;
}
```
